title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program 2027-2028
provider: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA), administered by Institute of International Education (IIE) and AMIDEAST
application_deadline: Varies by country; 2027-2028 cycle open now
application_opening_date: Varies by country; typically early 2026 through mid-2026
eligibility_summary: Citizens of participating countries (160+). Applicants apply through their home-country U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission. Must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent. For master's/doctoral study or research in the U.S. English proficiency required.
funding_details: Tuition and required fees, monthly stipend for room and board, round-trip transportation, supplemental health and accident coverage, book/equipment allowances. Up to two years of support.

title: Fulbright U.S. Student Program 2027-2028
provider: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA), administered by IIE
degree_levels: Master's, Doctorate, Non-degree research/study, Creative arts
application_deadline: National deadline: October 6, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time (campus deadlines typically 4-6 weeks earlier)
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens or permanent residents enrolled in or applying to U.S. undergraduate or graduate programs. Apply through campus Fulbright Program Adviser. Must not have extensive prior U.S. experience for certain awards.
funding_details: Varies by country/award; generally includes tuition, living stipend, travel, health insurance. Non-degree research grants and study/teaching grants available.
duration: Typically 9-12 months; grants must begin no later than June 1, 2028 for 2027-2028 cycle

title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program 2027-2028
provider: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA), administered by IIE
application_deadline: Varies by country; U.S. Embassy Jerusalem deadline: August 15, 2026. Embassies/Commissions must submit nominations to IIE by mid-September.
eligibility_summary: Mid-career professionals from eligible countries. Bachelor's degree required. Minimum 5 years full-time professional experience. Demonstrated leadership and public service commitment. Limited prior U.S. experience. English proficiency.
funding_details: Tuition and fees at host university, monthly living/settling-in allowance, accident and sickness insurance, book allowance, computer subsidy, round-trip international and domestic travel, professional development allowance.

title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars at Stanford University 2027 Cohort
application_deadline: October 6, 2026 at 1:00 PM Pacific Time (KHS application). Stanford graduate degree program deadline: earlier of program-specific deadline or December 1, 2026.
eligibility_summary: Citizens and residents of all countries. Must apply to a full-time Stanford graduate degree program. No quotas by region, discipline, or career field. Demonstrated independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and civic mindset.
funding_details: Up to 3 years of financial support including tuition funding, stipend for living and academic expenses, and annual travel stipend for one trip to/from Stanford.
duration: Up to 3 years (aligned with Stanford graduate degree length)

title: East-West Center Graduate Degree Fellowship 2027
application_deadline: December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Hawaii Standard Time
eligibility_summary: Citizens or permanent residents of the United States, or citizens of Asia-Pacific countries. Admission to University of Hawai'i at Manoa graduate program required by December 1. Priority given to applicants with commitment to Asia-Pacific region.
funding_details: General tuition and fees for UH Manoa graduate programs, housing in East-West Center dormitory, partial funding toward incidental expenses. Competitive funding available for field study and conference presentations.
duration: Up to 24 months; granted one year at a time and renewable

title: AAUW International Fellowships 2026-2027
application_deadline: September 17, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time
eligibility_summary: Women who are NOT U.S. citizens or permanent residents. Full-time study in STEM fields at accredited U.S. institution. Minimum GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale. Must begin program on or before September 15, 2027 and complete on or after April 30, 2028. TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 / Cambridge 176 / Duolingo DET 120.
funding_details: $20,000 per academic year for master's; $25,000 per academic year for doctoral. Paid in two equal installments (start and midpoint of fellowship year).

title: Rotary Peace Fellowship 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: Experienced peacebuilders from any country. Strong commitment to peace and conflict resolution. Proficiency in language of instruction at host university. Competitive selection by Rotary Foundation. Up to 170 fellows selected annually.
funding_details: Tuition and fees, housing and meals, round-trip transportation, internship and field-study expenses. Available at 9 partner universities worldwide, including new center at Symbiosis International University in Pune, India.
duration: 1-2 years depending on program (certificate or master's)

title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2026
provider: Government of Japan and World Bank
application_deadline: Developing Country Nationals: Window 1 closed February 27, 2026; Window 2 closed May 29, 2026. Japanese Nationals window closed April 17, 2026.
application_opening_date: Window 1: January 15, 2026; Window 2: March 30, 2026; Japanese Nationals: varies
eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible developing countries or Japanese nationals. Must be admitted to or enrolled in a participating master's or PhD program in a development-related field outside home country. Minimum 3 years full-time paid development-related employment since bachelor's degree. Bachelor's degree earned at least 3 years before application deadline.
funding_details: Tuition, monthly stipend, round-trip travel, health insurance, book allowance. Covers duration of graduate program or 2 years, whichever is less.

title: Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship (Fall 2026 Cycle)
provider: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA), administered by IIE
application_deadline: October 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Pacific Time (advisor certification deadline: October 8, 2026)
eligibility_summary: U.S. undergraduate students who have received a Federal Pell Grant. Studying or interning abroad on credit-bearing program starting between December 1, 2026 and October 31, 2027. Critical language study eligible for additional $3,000; STEM research eligible for additional $1,000.
funding_details: Up to $5,000 base award. Supplemental funding up to $3,000 for critical language study and up to $1,000 for STEM research overseas.

title: Boren Awards 2027-2028 (Scholarships and Fellowships)
provider: National Security Education Program (NSEP), administered by IIE
application_deadline: Boren Fellowships (graduate): January 20, 2027 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time. Boren Scholarships (undergraduate): January 27, 2027 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time.
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens. Undergraduates or graduate students in any field. Commitment to national security and language/cultural study abroad. Preference for study of less commonly taught languages and critical regions. Must study abroad for at least one semester.
funding_details: Scholarships: up to $20,000 for study abroad. Fellowships: up to $30,000 for year-long study abroad. Funding may be applied to programs starting June 2027 through March 1, 2028.

title: Phi Kappa Phi Fellowship 2026
provider: The Honor Society of Phi Kappa Phi
application_deadline: National deadline: April 15, 2026 (local chapter deadlines vary, typically 2 weeks earlier)
eligibility_summary: Active Phi Kappa Phi members (dues paid) or accepted members initiated by June 30, 2026. Seeking full-time enrollment in graduate/professional school beginning between May 1, 2026 and February 1, 2027. Not more than 9 graduate semester credits completed at application deadline. International students and accredited international institutions eligible.
funding_details: 48 Fellowships annually: two at $35,000, six at $15,000, and forty at $8,500 each.

title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
application_deadline: Field-specific deadlines in October 2026: Life Sciences Oct 19; CISE/Materials/ Psychology/Social Sciences Oct 20; Engineering Oct 22; Chemistry/Geosciences/Math/Physics Oct 23. All at 8:00 PM Eastern Time.
application_opening_date: Typically July or August 2026 (GRFP Application Module opens)
eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents. Graduate students in STEM fields or those pursuing research-based master's or doctoral degrees at accredited U.S. institutions. No more than 2 years of graduate study completed at application deadline.
funding_details: Annual stipend of $37,000 for 3 years, plus $16,000 cost-of-education allowance per year for tuition and fees. Total up to 3 years of support over 5-year period.

title: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
application_deadline: Restrictive Early Action / QuestBridge: Financial aid estimate mid-December. Regular Decision: around April 1, 2027. CSS Profile opens early October 2026.
eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions for all applicants including international. International students eligible for same aid as U.S. students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. FAFSA required for U.S. citizens/permanent residents.
funding_details: 100% of demonstrated financial need met without loans. Families below $100,000 income: free (tuition, fees, housing, food, travel, health insurance, startup/launch grants). Families below $200,000: at least free tuition. Average parent contribution $13,000. 55% of students receive scholarship aid.

title: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
application_deadline: Early Action International Citizens: December 1, 2026. Regular Decision: February 15, 2027. Transfer: April 1, 2027.
eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions. International students must indicate financial aid interest on admission application. CSS Profile not required for admissions/financial aid unless requested by office.
funding_details: 100% of demonstrated need met with scholarships (no loans). Families below $100,000: zero parent contribution, covers full cost including travel, health insurance, $2,000 startup grant. Families below $200,000: at least free tuition. International students eligible for travel allowances and health insurance support.
duration: 4 years (renewable; international students do not need to reapply annually)

title: MIT Undergraduate Financial Aid for International Students 2026-2027
application_deadline: Early Action: November 30, 2025 (for 2026-27). Regular Action: February 15, 2026 (for 2026-27).
eligibility_summary: All applicants including international students. Need-blind, need-based, full-need for all students regardless of citizenship. International students follow same process as domestic. CSS Profile and IDOC required.
funding_details: 100% of demonstrated financial need met. MIT Scholarship is primary grant aid (no repayment). Median MIT Scholarship $69,777 (2024-25). Families below $100,000: zero parent contribution. Families below $200,000: tuition-free.

title: UT Austin International Student Scholarships (Spring 2027 and Fall 2027)
provider: The University of Texas at Austin
application_deadline: Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 scholarships: November 1, 2026. Fall 2027 and 2027-2028 academic year scholarships: March 1, 2027.
application_opening_date: Spring/Summer scholarships: October 1, 2026. Fall/Academic Year scholarships: February 1, 2027.
eligibility_summary: International students meeting eligibility criteria for specific scholarships. Apply via LASSO university-wide scholarship system using keyword 'ISSS'. Must be admitted or enrolled at UT Austin.
funding_details: Amounts vary by scholarship. Multiple scholarships available with different criteria.
duration: Varies by scholarship (term or academic year)

title: University of Chicago International Scholarships for Undergraduates
application_deadline: January 2, 2027 (Regular Decision for 2027 entry)
application_opening_date: CSS Profile available per admission cycle
eligibility_summary: International students applying for undergraduate admission. Need-blind admissions for international students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. Demonstrates full financial need for all admitted students.
funding_details: Full-ride financial aid based on demonstrated need. Covers tuition, fees, housing, meals, books, personal expenses, and travel.

title: Carnegie Mellon University Africa Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
provider: Carnegie Mellon University Africa (CMU-Africa) and Mastercard Foundation
application_deadline: January 15, 2027
eligibility_summary: Young African citizens committed to using technical education to benefit their communities. Demonstrated financial need. Strong academic performance. Bachelor's degree or final year student. Programs: MSIT, MSECE, MSEAI.
funding_details: Full funding including tuition, fees, housing, meals, stipend, travel, and related expenses for master's degree at CMU-Africa in Kigali, Rwanda.

title: Google PhD Fellowship Program 2027 (anticipated)
application_deadline: 2026 cycle closed April 30, 2026; 2027 cycle typically March-April 2027
application_opening_date: 2026 cycle opened March 5, 2026; 2027 cycle expected March 2027
eligibility_summary: Full-time PhD students in eligible research areas (AI/ML, systems, security, quantum, HCI, etc.). Must be nominated by eligible university; direct student applications not accepted. Available across multiple regions worldwide.
funding_details: Up to 2-year fellowship. U.S. and Canada: approximately $85,000 per year toward education costs (tuition and fees), living expenses, travel, and personal equipment.

title: Trinity University International Academic Scholarships and Financial Aid
application_deadline: February 1, 2026 (same as application deadline)
eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants. Automatically awarded at time of admission. No separate scholarship application. No undergraduate application fee. Apply through Common Application.
funding_details: Generous merit-based scholarships and need-based financial aid up to the cost of attendance. #37 National Liberal Arts College.

title: JWU Global Full Tuition Scholarship
application_deadline: January 4, 2026 (Early Action 2 deadline for undergraduate application)
eligibility_summary: Non-U.S. citizen incoming undergraduate full-time students. Must be invited to apply through JWU Admissions Portal after completing undergraduate application by Early Action 2 deadline (January 4, 2026). Demonstrated leadership through extracurricular, volunteer, or entrepreneurial activities. Must submit Global Impact Statement and two letters of recommendation.
funding_details: Full tuition scholarship for undergraduate degree at JWU.
